maria (Docs): Hey @jon @sam — PR #842 updates the SDK streaming example to include a `timeout_ms` param. The docs preview CI is failing for the canary preview with `timeout waiting for runtime response`. Is this a docs-only change or do we need a runtime hotfix?

jon (Runtime): Do you have the failing log snippet? The runtime default for streaming requests should be 60s unless overridden by routing policy.

maria (Docs): CI log shows: `Error: stream init failed: timeout after 30000ms`. The SDK example sets `timeout_ms: 30000` in the snippet we added. We thought documenting the shorter client timeout was fine but the preview runner hits it.

sam (SDK): Ah, the SDK default used to be 60s but we recently tightened some examples to 30s to encourage retries. The runtime will still hold 60s for server-side, but client-level timeouts can abort earlier — which will surface as that error in the docs preview.

aaron (Docs): So the PR is technically correct: example recommending 30s. But CI uses the hosted canary runtime which keeps the connection open and the docs preview runner treats client abort as a failure.

jon (Runtime): Right. For the preview infra we treat any client-initiated stream abort as an error because we want deterministic previews. We can relax that for docs preview if needed.

maria (Docs): Is that something you can toggle for this canary run, or should we change the example back to 60s to get the PR unstuck?

jon (Runtime): I can flip a flag for just the PR preview to ignore client-aborts within the first 65s. If you want to proceed quickly, change the snippet to `timeout_ms: 60000` and add a short note about recommended production behavior. Either works.

sam (SDK): If you change the snippet, add a code comment: `// client timeout may be shorter for UX, runtime fallback is 60s` — helps reduce confusion.

maria (Docs): Thanks. I'll update the snippet and add a small callout explaining the difference between client SDK timeout and server-side stream retention. Then we can re-run CI. If CI still fails, @jon please toggle the preview flag. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: ci/docs-preview #842 — started canary build (canary-run-329). Logs will be available at https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/329

aaron (Docs): Sounds good. Leaving a comment on the PR with the decision and ETA for re-run.

maria (Docs): PR updated to use 60000 and added callout. Re-running preview now.

ci-bot: ci/docs-preview #842 — canary build finished, status: success :white_check_mark:

maria (Docs): Great — merging once any stale approvals are still valid. Thanks everyone!
